schemes.basis_ko: 이번 선택칸 검토7모델의2.510–9.880kW 분포를 보기 위한 잠정 경계. 산업표준·물리변곡점이 아니다. R410A·inverter twin rotary·1제조사에 한정.
보유 Panasonic 사양서에서 확인한9/12/16kW 9모델 구분용 잠정 경계. 공기–물·정격난방 조건을 공기–공기 냉방 자료와 합치지 않는다. 제조사 제어속도 미공개는 그대로 null.

unknown_rule: unknown/null/empty CSV field means not established; never false or zero

linear_units.capacity_value_kw: kW, declared rating not observed point output
linear_units.rating_speed_rps: physical revolutions/s only, never supply Hz
linear_units.capacity_original_value: as printed; no capacity heating/cooling transformation

pressure_rule: gauge and absolute raw states remain separate; no property calculations in this intake
air_temperature_rule: DB/WB/RH columns stay separate; no wet-bulb substitution or inferred DB
control_boundary_rule: defrost/cycling/heater included/excluded/unknown/not-applicable per table/point; test-standard label is not proof
field_dictionary_review: 161 experiment fields: current raw header/drawing mapping vs 2026-10-18 semantic source review explicitly distinguished in reviewed_scope
legacy_model_review: 137 compressor + 624 airflow previous project observations indexed, not newly verified source values; old eligible ignored. Mode/side/fan-step condition keys remain separate.
